title: Synthesis and application of Fe/Ni modified ZIF-8 as an environmentally friendly photocatalyst for methylene blue dye degradation under visible light
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44893-44908
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05662D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Siti Saenab, Oka Pradipta Arjasa, Fajar Inggit Pambudi, Dwi Siswanta
A series of Fe(III) and Ni(II) bimetallic doped ZIF-8 materials were synthesized via a facile, green, room-temperature method to act as highly efficient photocatalysts for methylene blue (MB) degradation.
